captions.detailed: A solid rear vehicle axle featuring a central spherical differential housing with an input shaft, flanked by two cylindrical axle tubes. At each end, there is a dual-wheel assembly consisting of two thick black rubber tires mounted on a grey metallic hub. The dual-wheel assemblies on both the left and right sides are designed to rotate independently about the axle's longitudinal axis via continuous revolute joints.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a solid rear vehicle axle assembly. It should feature a central differential housing with an input shaft, two extending axle shafts, and dual-wheel assemblies on both sides. Apply a dark grey material to the axle structure, light grey to the wheel hubs, and black to the tires, ensuring the dual wheels are articulated to rotate continuously about their respective hub joints.
captions.factory: The axle assembly is constructed by first creating a central differential housing using a sphere intersected with a cylinder, combined with a cylindrical input shaft and two lateral cylindrical axle tubes. Each wheel hub is modeled by fusing concentric cylinders of varying diameters and lengths. The tires are generated as cylinders with central holes. The components are organized into an articulated assembly where the left and right dual-wheel parts are connected to the central axle frame using continuous revolute joints aligned along the lateral axis.
